name: GRS-3 Rybinsk-Chernaya Rechka-Okhotino Inter-settlement Gas Pipeline (Yaroslavl Oblast)

values.PipelineName: GRS-3 Rybinsk-Chernaya Rechka-Okhotino Inter-settlement Gas Pipeline (Yaroslavl Oblast)
values.OtherEnglishNames: Rybinsk-Chernaya Rechka-Okhotino inter-settlement gas pipeline; GRS-3 Rybinsk-sanatorium Chernaya Rechka-Okhotino gas pipeline
values.RouteNotes: No published route geometry found; endpoints and waypoint only (GRS-3 Rybinsk -> sanatorium Chernaya Rechka, Rybinsk district -> Okhotino, Myshkino district). Spur settlements: Pokrovskoye, Nikolskoye, Nikola-Korma, Eremeytsevo, Yukhot, Palyushino.

researcher_notes: Not in roster: GGIT_gas_working.csv has no Rybinsk/Okhotino/Chernaya Rechka row; distinct from P4012 (Gorky-Cherepovets / Burmakino-Rybinsk, proposed trunk) and P4013 (Borok-Breytovo, Breytovo district). Threshold met: (a) sponsor Gazprom group (Gazprom Mezhregiongaz project under Gazprom 2021-2025 gas supply and gasification programme; Gazprom Invest / Gazprom Gazifikatsiya technical customer per neftegaz 24 Aug 2021); (b) Rybinsk (GRS-3) to Okhotino, Rybinsk and Myshkino districts, Yaroslavl Oblast; (c) concrete step = built: commissioned 7 Sep 2023 by Gazprom gazoraspredelenie Yaroslavl and Rybinskgazservis (yaroblgaz.ru), after construction start 23-24 Aug 2021 and a Feb 2023 near-completion report (rweek.ru citing Rybinsk district administration); (d) length sourced 42.5 km (neftegaz, planned) and 43 km as built (yaroblgaz, rounded) so recorded 42.5, >=25 km. Window: operating line GEM never captured. One line, not a settlement chain: a single named trunk with distribution networks built in each settlement. Classed distribution like P4013 (feeds ~400 households + 3 coal boilers); borderline vs the urban-distribution exclusion but it is an inter-settlement 42 km spur, not an urban network. Owner/Parent set to Gazprom PJSC by convention (other D5 shards); operating entity Gazprom gazoraspredelenie Yaroslavl (no close GEM entity; do not create as owner without confirming ownership). Diameter, capacity, cost not found (mrg.gazprom.ru press release URL timed out in url_verifier so not cited). Route: none found. Confidence: high for existence/status/length (two sources, one validated suffices); medium for Owner; Owner/Parent ref = neftegaz (Gazprom Mezhregiongaz project under the Gazprom programme; no source states legal asset ownership explicitly, so medium).
